oneLine: Oyo parent Prism is exploring an IPO launch in November.

sources.title: Oyo parent Prism likely to launch IPO in November

synopsis: Oyo parent Prism is exploring an initial public offering to be launched in November, aiming to raise Rs 6,650 crore entirely through a fresh issue of shares according to its updated draft red herring prospectus. The company is holding discussions with investors to assess demand and market conditions, with final timing to be recommended by book running lead managers. The bulk of the proceeds, specifically Rs 4,987.5 crore, is earmarked for investment in a subsidiary, Oravel Stays Singapore Pte Ltd, for the repayment or prepayment of certain borrowings, while the remaining net proceeds will support general corporate purposes. The proposed IPO does not include an offer for sale by existing shareholders.
